title: To reauthorize the Fort Peck Reservation Rural Water System Act of 2000.
latestAction: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported without amendment favorably.
summary: This bill reauthorizes through FY2028 the planning, design, and construction of the Assiniboine and Sioux Rural Water System and the Dry Prairie Rural Water System, both located in Montana.
